verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is that users can opt out of model training in Settings. That is a related data-use control, but it is not the same as disabling telemetry or usage analytics, so this is only glancing support for the story. Missing for 10: any documented opt-out for telemetry or usage tracking, details on what usage data is collected, admin or workspace-level controls over analytics, and independent or hands-on confirmation.
